name: frequency<-
title: Replacing the Frequency of an Object

origin.description: frequency<- stores value and marks the series as a zooreg when value times each step is an integer. On a plain zoo, a frequency greater than 1 that is within tolerance of an integer is rounded.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An object. A zoo series stores observations separately from its index.

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: A frequency that divides the index spacing. A value just above an integer greater than 1 is rounded.

origin.details: frequency<- stores value and marks the series as a zooreg when value times each step is an integer. On a plain zoo, a frequency greater than 1 that is within tolerance of an integer is rounded.
origin.value: The series with the new frequency.

translation.example:
import numpy as np
from zoo.series import Zoo
from zoo.is_regular import frequency_set
z = frequency_set(Zoo(np.arange(1, 6), [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]), 3)
print(int(z.frequency))
